title: 翻個面
subject: a Harbin bathhouse scrubber who has scrubbed the factory director and the factory gatekeeper for thirty years and says their backs look exactly the same
caption: Northeastern Chinese folk-tune storytelling pop. A bright, nasal banhu fiddle playing the lead tune and answering each line; suona fills at the end of each verse; bamboo clappers clacking on every beat; a cheap electronic stage keyboard pumping the chords like a village folk-opera troupe; an electric bass bouncing on one and three; a dry pop kit with handclaps and call-and-response stops. Dry and close like the back room of an old bathhouse, the banhu and the voice forward, a small group chorus behind. Male voice, a gravelly, nasal baritone, half-sung and half-recited in a sly, satirical storyteller delivery with Northeastern speech rhythm, and a small group chorus shouting the answers. 120 BPM, G major. Sly, steamy and satirical. No guzheng, no Peking opera falsetto, no free-rhythm hua'er calls, no accordion, no frame drum, no dutar, no trap drums, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, banhu tune over bamboo clappers]

[Verse 1]
哈爾濱道外 老澡堂子 熱氣冒到大馬路上
搓澡的老孫 一條搓澡巾 搓了三十年
進門的人 有的坐小轎車 有的騎二八大槓
衣服一脫 鑰匙往手腕上一套 誰也不認識誰

[Chorus - group answers]
來 翻個面 (翻個面!)
廠長的後背 跟看大門的老王 一個樣
來 翻個面 (翻個面!)
搓下來的泥 也沒比誰多一兩

[Verse 2]
有一回廠長來了 倆秘書在門口等著
他說老孫 你給我好好搓 明天我要上台講話
老孫說 你趴好 你這肚子 比你們廠的庫存還多
廠長嘿嘿一笑 說你這張嘴 比你那毛巾還狠

[Chorus - group answers]
來 翻個面 (翻個面!)
廠長的後背 跟看大門的老王 一個樣
來 翻個面 (翻個面!)
出了這個門 你再接著當你的廠長

[Bridge - clappers and handclaps only, call and response]
水熱不熱 (熱!)
勁大不大 (大!)
二十塊錢 (值!)

[Outro - suona fill, banhu closes the tune]
老孫說 我這輩子沒記住誰的臉
後背倒是 一個都沒忘
